channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's curated vulnerabilities highlight a severe threat landscape dominated by remote code execution and authentication bypass flaws across desktop operating systems, cloud infrastructure, and network devices, with Microsoft products facing the highest volume of critical issues including unauthenticated RCE in Windows components, SQL Server, and Azure services. Significant risks also extend to IoT ecosystems where command injection and buffer overflows in routers and gateways from vendors like TP-Link, D-Link, and Ubiquiti enable full device compromise, while industrial control systems and database middleware suffer from deserialization and injection attacks threatening operational integrity. Notably, actively exploited vulnerabilities include a local privilege escalation in the Windows Update Stack and remote command injection in AhsayCBS backup software, underscoring immediate dangers to enterprise environments.
